name: Castaway Island
blurb: A scrap of sand, palms and reef somewhere in the western Caribbean.

name: The Cayes
blurb: A fishing town on the Belize coast, and the mangroves, patch reefs and channels inside the barrier reef.

name: Rio Negro
blurb: A blackwater river the colour of strong tea, an archipelago of a thousand islands, white beaches at low water and a forest that stands in the river at high.
voyage: A freighter to Belém, then nine days up the Amazon on a river boat with the hammocks slung three deep, then a smaller boat up the Negro, where the water turns black and the sand turns white. Porto Mariuá, at last.

waterNotes.low: Beaches out, the lagoons cut off and crowded, the forest dry
waterNotes.rising: The beaches are going under and the forest edge is starting to flood
waterNotes.high: The forest is flooded, and the fish have gone into it
waterNotes.falling: The water is leaving the forest, and the fish are leaving with it
